svg.title: Extractium workflow
svg.desc: Websites and portals, GitHub repositories, library repositories, YouTube captions, local folders, and knowledge bundles feed one Extractium build. The search index supports websites, scripts, local AI, and hosted search. llms.txt files support web-browsing AI. SQLite supports queries, reports, and hosted databases. Markdown supports reading, editing, and reuse through Open Knowledge Format. Plug-ins can add sources and outputs.

g.aria-label: One build, several ways to use your knowledge
